source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Solid full-length lines divide the grid into matching panels.
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1) if row_bounds[i+1] > row_bounds[i]+1]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1) if col_bounds[i+1] > col_bounds[i]+1]
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    panels = []
    for ra, rb in row_spans:
        for ca, cb in col_spans:
            panels.append((ra, rb, ca, cb, sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(ra, rb) for c in range(ca, cb))))
    src = max(panels, key=lambda p: p[4])
    ra, rb, ca, cb, _ = src
    pattern = [row[ca:cb] for row in grid[ra:rb]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1, _ in panels:
        if r1-r0 == len(pattern) and c1-c0 == len(pattern[0]):
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                out[r0+dr][c0:c1] = pattern[dr][:]
    return out
'''
